claim_summary: For every finite vertex-transitive graph \(H\) of order \(m\ge2\), the fastest symmetric stochastic SLEM of \(K_1\vee H\) equals \((m-1)/m\) times the fastest symmetric stochastic SLEM of \(H\); the same factor is a universal upper bound and can be strict for the four-vertex path.
scientific_integrity: Exact proof supplied; source comparisons and residual literature risks in AUDIT.json; calculations supplemental rather than exhaustive proof.
scientific_limitations: Symmetric uniform-stationary stochastic matrices with holding; no stationary-weight or nonreversible extension; base optimum may remain unknown. Wheel specialization already in arXiv:0709.0955; general cone identity checked against accessible sources only.
title: Exact cone-transfer law for fastest symmetric Markov mixing
